ValidationRule.description: Validation to check if Email value is provided in proper format.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'CCRM_Lead', NOT ISBLANK( Email ) , NOT REGEX( Email , "^[a-zA-Z0-9.'+-]{2,}@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]{2,}.[a-zA-Z]{2,}$" ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Skip_Validations__c)), NOT(OR( Skip_Validations__c = 'SkipValidation', Skip_Validations__c = 'Validate' )) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please enter Email in correct format.
